Odnix Terms & Privacy

A simple guide to using the community.

Community Guidelines

  • Use your real or chosen display name responsibly and do not impersonate others.
  • Be respectful. Harassment, threats, hate, spam and unlawful content are not allowed.
  • Only share content you created or have permission to use.
  • Do not post private information about yourself or anyone else.

Account & Eligibility

Provide accurate account information. You must meet the minimum age and location requirements that apply to you. Keep your sign-in details private and tell us if you believe your account has been accessed without permission.

Privacy

Odnix uses the information you submit, such as your name, username and email, to create and operate your account. Your profile and posts may be visible to signed-in users according to the app's current settings. Do not share sensitive personal information.

Content & Account Safety

You are responsible for the content you publish. We may restrict access to content or accounts that violate these rules. These are starter community terms for this prototype and should be reviewed before public launch.
